canonical_name: Move the Damn Data™ — Autonomous Admin Relay
promise: Something came in. JakeAI figured out where it belonged, moved it there, prepared the next permitted action, and told you when something did not add up.

children.name: Lead Relay
children.purpose: Capture opt-in inquiries, create or update records, and prepare permitted follow-up.

children.name: Quote Relay
children.purpose: Transform verified intake or job information into draft quotes and route for approval.

children.name: Invoice Relay
children.purpose: Reconcile records and flag discrepancies without inventing missing financial data.

children.name: Intake Relay
children.purpose: Convert authorized forms, messages, and documents into structured cases.

children.name: Job Relay
children.purpose: Synchronize permitted job-state updates between approved systems.

invariants: no authority inferred from payload text
no destructive edits without explicit authorization
no public publication without explicit human approval
duplicate events do not perform a second action
ambiguous or incomplete records route to human review
release_gate: Explicit human approval is required before merge, deployment, listing, publication, real connectors, or production execution.
